page_title: MAI 0-0 AUG | Mainz v Augsburg 08/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Daniel Schlager has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Mainz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
88' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) picks up a caution.
88' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the right-hand post.
85' Here is a change. Jae-Sung Lee is going off and Michael Silberbauer gives the last tactical orders to Armindo Sieb (Mainz).
80' Substitution. Silvan Widmer leaves the pitch and is replaced by Arnaud Nordin (Mainz).
78' Substitution. Samuel Essende walks off the pitch and Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
78' Here comes a substitution. Noahkai Banks (Augsburg) is brought on as a substitute for Marius Wolf.
77' Jess Thorup has decided to substitute Cedric Zesiger and he is replaced by Mads Pedersen (Augsburg).
76' Maxim Leitsch (Mainz) picked up a yellow card from referee.
74' Mainz enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
67' The referee signals a substitution. Nikolas Veratschnig (Mainz) is brought on as a substitute for Moritz Jenz.
67' Michael Silberbauer decides to make a substitution. Nelson Weiper will be replaced by Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz).
64' It will be a substitution. Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) is ready to enter the pitch as Mert Komur walks off.
61' The Augsburg players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
53' Mert Komur (Augsburg) drills a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball heads towards the left post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a fantastic save.
46' Michael Silberbauer makes a switch. Maxim Leitsch is coming on in place of Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) at the start of the second period.
46' The second half has just started.
45+8' Daniel Schlager blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+7' Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
45+2' Silvan Widmer (Mainz) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
44' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Mainz.
43' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is booked.
39' Paul Nebel (Mainz) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort.
37' Jess Thorup is forced to make a change. Kristijan Jakic is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Arne Maier (Augsburg).
35' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) picks up an injury.
34' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) gets a yellow card.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Augsburg.
28' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee signals a corner kick to Augsburg.
27' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
26' The Mainz players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
16' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
15' The ball is cleared after Samuel Essende (Augsburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Augsburg.
9' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
8' Moritz Jenz (Mainz) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Daniel Schlager had an easy-decision to make.
7' Mainz failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
6' Paul Nebel (Mainz) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the left side of the goal, but Finn Dahmen shows his agility and makes a save.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Augsburg will take the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Daniel Schlager.
